patch.value: Docstring corrections: filters, graph-canvas, crypto, board, pm routes, project-watcher, sse, mutation-event-watcher

Corrected inaccurate JSDoc across 8 files: filters.ts (unknown keys ignored, not defaulted), graph-canvas.ts (reheat sets not raises alpha; edge bundling biased toward not through centroid), crypto.ts (only IV/authTag/ciphertext base64url-encoded), board.ts (declared-status order not first-seen), routes/pm.ts (item-updated carries itemId/change/target not from/to), project-watcher.ts (positiveIntEnv leading-integer parsing; FNV-1a not collision-free), sse.ts (no-client call not a no-op), mutation-event-watcher.ts (same positiveIntEnv fix).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Files changed: public/src/filters.ts, public/src/views/graph-canvas.ts, src/crypto.ts, src/board.ts, src/routes/pm.ts, src/services/project-watcher.ts, src/services/sse.ts, src/services/mutation-event-watcher.ts. Also: scripts/docstring-gate.ts (entry-guard fix: throws on unresolvable argv[1] instead of returning false), test/docstring-gate.test.ts (new test file, 9 tests).
